name: Lot
overview: Lot, the son of Haran, journeyed with Abram (later Abraham) from Ur of the Chaldees to Haran and then to Canaan, faithfully accompanying him through significant transitions (Genesis 11:31; 12:4; 13:1). He prospered materially, possessing flocks, herds, and tents, reflecting God's blessing amid his association with Abraham (Genesis 13:5). Despite this, Lot ultimately separated from Abraham by choosing to dwell in Sodom, a decision that led to his capture by enemy kings and subsequent rescue by Abraham, as well as his narrow escape from Sodom’s destruction, highlighting both divine providence and human frailty (Genesis 14:1; 19:17).
